context: Judges a remediation of one conformance finding (colour literals in styled components) for completeness and restraint.

checklist.name: literals_replaced
checklist.description: All hex and rgb() colour literals used as styled-component colours in the files named by the finding are replaced with theme.colors references.

checklist.name: reuses_existing_tokens
checklist.description: Where an existing theme token already has the same value (for example #5262a8 is otelBlue), the existing token is used instead of adding a duplicate.

checklist.name: new_tokens_in_theme
checklist.description: Any colour without an existing token is added to styles/Theme.ts (and its theme type, if one exists) with a descriptive name, rather than left as a literal.

checklist.name: visual_parity
checklist.description: Each replacement maps to the same colour value as the literal it replaced.

checklist.name: in_scope
checklist.description: No unrelated refactoring, formatting churn or behaviour changes outside colour usage.

checklist.name: tokens_defined
checklist.description: Every theme.colors key the change references is defined in styles/Theme.ts and, if the theme has a type declaration, in that type too.
